item.title: Allergens (full list)
item.description: Allergens: 1. Gluten 2. Eggs 3. Fish 4. Peanuts 5. Crustaceans 6. Milk 7. Soy 8. Sesame 9. Nuts 10. Celery 11. Mustard 12. Lupine 13. Sulphur dioxide 14. Molluscs 15. Garlic

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Danish fish cakes with roasted potatoes, topped with steamed broccoli. Served with remoulade, cucumber salad and lemon on the side. (1+2+3+10+11)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Turkish tantuni with chicken, vegetables and rice. Served with lime, red onion salad with sumac and parsley, lemon yoghurt and pickled mild peppers on the side. Also available gluten free. (1+6+11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Turkish tantuni with tofu, vegetables and rice. Served with lime, red onion salad with sumac and parsley, lemon yoghurt and pickled mild peppers on the side. Also available gluten free. (1+6+7+11+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Spanish-inspired chorizo paella, beautifully spiced and topped with crisp frisée and parsley. (4+10+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Paella with chickpeas and the spices we know from chorizo, topped with crisp bitter leaves and parsley. (10+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Crispy fried fish fillet with new potatoes and creamy parsley sauce. (1+3+6) GREEN DISH: Dish Vegetable patty with new potatoes and creamy parsley sauce. (1+6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Indonesian pork neck rendang, slow-cooked and aromatic in spiced coconut milk, served with nasi lemak, Indonesian coconut rice, topped with roasted cashews and spring onion. Served with fresh cucumber, pineapple, Thai basil, chilli oil and coriander on the side. (3+7+9+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Indonesian tofu rendang, slow-cooked and aromatic in spiced coconut milk, served with nasi lemak, Indonesian coconut rice, topped with roasted cashews and spring onion. Served with fresh cucumber, pineapple, Thai basil, chilli oil and coriander on the side. (7+9+15)
